title: Safety-Critical AI Validation

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Safety-Critical AI Validation": Validate AI models used near safety-critical engineering decisions with independent test sets, failure analysis and operating limits so only models with documented evidence are released for use. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training metrics as evidence.
